rationale: The Kimi Coding calibration was censored by a billing-cycle quota at checkpoint 4. ModelArts MaaS Kimi passed a fresh native MiniSWE tool-call probe, so this is a new provider-specific run from checkpoint 1 rather than a continuation or splice.

candidates.reason: Six-checkpoint workflow recalibrated end to end on the MaaS provider before any MaaS execution_server treatment output exists.

prefix_selection_rule.select: Choose the longest prefix k for which every checkpoint 1 through k has no infrastructure failure, checkpoints 1 through k-1 explicitly complete before action 32, checkpoint k explicitly completes before action 32, and checkpoint k normalized Core and all-test scores are each at least 0.50.
prefix_selection_rule.headroom: The terminal checkpoint must fail at least one collected test or one Core test. If it is perfect, step back to the longest earlier qualifying non-perfect checkpoint.
prefix_selection_rule.abandon: If no prefix of at least 3 qualifies, do not run the MaaS recursive manager contrast on execution_server.

formal_if_valid.replication_policy: If treatment-control all-test gaps are negative at both final checkpoints, add two identical independent replicates. Otherwise stop this model-task-provider pair.
